set.body:
Own the connector-independent table contract of D08. One implementation supplies the table and dictionary behavior for both records. D08 retains its separately scheduled source-specific adapter.

Acceptance criteria

1. Participant, session, scan and phenotype tables retain their table identity, keys, source release, raw values and dictionary definitions including coded levels, units and missing values where supplied.
2. Two studies with a field named score but different instruments or units and two people called sub-01 stay distinct. Cross-study pooling requires an explicit mapping. An unmapped or incompatible pair has a defined outcome.
3. An independent reader can recover the permitted dictionary and reproduce a frozen mixed BOLD/EEG/questionnaire selection from the files and declared query semantics.
4. Denied columns and rows remain absent in a restricted selection and its export. Reference and PostgreSQL answers match a hand-authored oracle, including missing or censored values.

Verification

Two small BIDS/TSV/JSON studies with exact expected membership, dictionary values and allowed export file contents. No live EDC service is needed.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: PRO04: Deliver the table and dictionary portion of D08 across two studies
